description: Terminal cron target. Starts one code-only background pass; active-colour and single-flight guards return started, already_running or inactive immediately. Reads the register CLI and fleet snapshots, stores current and immutable historical KV marker records, and sends <role> only on semantic change or first actionable pending delivery, explicit STOP event or overdue lane. Complete unchanged ticks send nothing. Failed/truncated domains are unmeasured, never quiet. A full unit/candidate/verdict/event/landing fallback covers incomplete resume. Intent is durable before send; uncertain effects are reconciled against exact persisted role envelopes and never replayed. Persisted mail is not proof of a model wake. Marker maintenance operations read, correct and clear require current record identity and a reason for writes, preserve intent custody and retain immutable history; a cleared marker reinitializes a baseline. These operations are for the owning operator, never cron arguments. Read historical records by record_id. No model or inference is used.
embedding_description: Run a code-only main-seat heartbeat that reads complete register and fleet state and sends the runtime seat role only for semantic changes or actionable overdue work. Quiet ticks create no mail. Retain durable marker history, send intent and exact-envelope recovery without replaying uncertain effects.
